_doc: Every test file that performs filesystem writes, with a reviewed statement of where those writes land and why that is safe. Enforced by tools/validate-test-writes.mjs: a writing test without an entry fails, and an entry whose file is gone or no longer writes fails. Written after two same-day incidents (2026-09-05): the cartridge self-test clobbered the real neft-library artifact on every npm test, and a sandbox test overwrote six real lesson configs when a refactor broke its generator's root redirection.

Every write goes into mkdtempSync directories under os.tmpdir(): small synthetic trees (a manifest, an engine file, a lesson page) with and without a seeded purple literal, which the real gate is pointed at through --root.
